en.title: The Boy Who Refused to Accept It | Dhruva Part 1 of 2
en.description:
A five-year-old boy was pushed off his father's lap. His stepmother laughed. His father said nothing.

So the boy walked into the forest alone, to find the one thing no one could take from him.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 4, chapters 8-9. The Vishnu Purana tells this story with some differences.
